_published_faq.name: How do I add findadomain-api to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add findadomain-api to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.findadomain.dev/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is findadomain-api MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 15, 2026, findadomain-api scores 94/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: How clear is findadomain-api's MCP tool documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 15, 2026, findadomain-api scores 69/100 in Manufact's review of tool titles, descriptions, input and output schemas, and behavior annotations. The review covers 2 of 2 discovered tools. The quality score measures documentation clarity; runtime behavior and marketplace readiness require separate checks.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to findadomain-api?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to findadomain-api in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.

_published_faq.name: How can findadomain-api improve its MCP documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: check_domain is the lowest-scoring reviewed tool at 67/100. No output schema is declared. Add one for structured results so clients can interpret returned fields.
